projectProfitabilityCalculation.formula: Project GP = Net Revenue - Product COGS - Freight COGS - Installation COGS - Direct Project Costs
projectProfitabilityCalculation.productCOGS: Supplier FOB price + import freight + insurance + import duty (5%) + customs clearance
projectProfitabilityCalculation.freightCOGS: Australian domestic freight from warehouse to site
projectProfitabilityCalculation.installationCOGS: Installation crew labour (hours × rate) + travel + incidentals
projectProfitabilityCalculation.directProjectCosts: Project-specific design/CAD fees, sample costs, site visit costs
projectProfitabilityCalculation.targetGP: 32–40% of net revenue for a standard project

supplyOnly.note: Lower service burden — but no installation margin and lower client lock-in

managedProject.description: Supply, delivery coordination, and installation included
managedProject.note: Installation adds 8–15% additional margin; project management time adds 2–4% cost

premiumProject.description: $100k+ with dedicated PM, site visits, phased delivery
premiumProject.note: Scale benefits margin — supplier volume discounts kick in above $50k COGS

profitabilityWarningThresholds.review: GM below 28% — requires CEO review before proceeding
profitabilityWarningThresholds.decline: GM below 22% — do not proceed unless there is strategic client relationship value
profitabilityWarningThresholds.investigate: GM dropped post-project — investigate cause to prevent recurrence

postProjectReconciliation.when: Within 2 weeks of project completion and final invoice payment
process: Compare actual supplier cost to quoted cost — identify variances
Compare actual freight cost to estimated freight — identify variances
Compare actual installation hours to estimated hours
Calculate final GM% and compare to quoted GM%
Record variance reason for future quote accuracy improvement
postProjectReconciliation.improvement: Track 5 consecutive project post-mortems — patterns emerge that allow systematic quote accuracy improvement of 3–5% GM

supplierVolumeThresholds.strategic: Above $200,000 COGS/year — renegotiate annual pricing framework
supplierVolumeThresholds.note: Volume leverage with suppliers is a significant margin improvement mechanism as TCD scales
